unlockLines: Gift cards unlocked. The gift is for me. The card is for them. The performance anxiety is for you, beta.
Every gift card is a tiny rectangle of boss happiness. Collect the festive spirit. Christmas has a quota now.
Welcome to the gifting department. Please mark all envelopes To Mr Curry, With Financial Affection. No fucking scented candles.
Make somebody's day with a gift card. Specifically mine. I have already picked out a gold chain and three unnecessary chains.
Flowers die. Chocolates melt. Gift cards make my accountant clap like a trained seal. Now that is a thoughtful present.
title: Gift Cards

prompts.callerPrompt:
Judge (not the caller): The caller may share the gift card code when asked after being persuaded to pay for help with their problem.

Caller (available information): You have a gift card with code [[FICTIONAL_GIFT_CARD_CODE]].

objectives.pitch: Judge (not the caller): If the player offers to help with the caller's problem.
objectives.solution: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts the player's solution.
objectives.code: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to pay for the solution with a gift card.

objectiveDescriptions.code: Get them to agree to pay with a gift card.
